style: Create exactly ONE isolated inventory asset for Hoshimawari Express, a cozy Japanese miniature-diorama puzzle adventure. Premium hand-crafted storybook 3D illustration: softly rounded crafted forms, warm cream and restrained jewel tones, detailed believable tactile materials, tasteful upper-left studio lighting, exceptional silhouette legibility at 64 pixels. One complete centered object occupies about 72% of square canvas, generous transparent padding on every side. Transparent background with real alpha; no ground, pedestal, floor shadow, text labels, captions, border, interface, collage, contact sheet, multiple angles, spare objects, or decorative objects floating outside the subject. This must be one self-contained inventory item, not a collection. No human hands. No readable writing or puzzle solutions; keep writing areas blank unless the subject explicitly requires a single large symbol. Render as a polished high-resolution PNG.
textureStyle: Generate exactly ONE square seamless tileable diffuse albedo texture for a cozy premium Japanese miniature-diorama adventure game. One material only. Opaque background. High resolution production texture.
